message.content:
To log in to your **Wells Fargo credit card** account, go to the Wells Fargo website and select **“Sign On”** to enter your username and password.[1][2]

If you have not enrolled yet, the enrollment flow is available from the same site, and you can then access your credit card account through **Wells Fargo Online** or the **Wells Fargo Mobile** app.[2]

If you want, I can also help with:
- **forgot username/password**
- **new account enrollment**
- **mobile app sign-in**
